approvedSequenceToRequest: Recheck exact source hashes, project identity, mode QA and isolated sheet ID immediately before execution.
Grant only the two disclosed scopes for this QA project.
Run prepararAmbienteQAMobile in the authenticated owner editor; it privately binds QA ADMIN_EMAIL and creates a new QA HMAC_SECRET without exposing values.
Deploy a versioned QA Web App as the owner, with anonymous access explicitly approved; record actual deployment ID/version/exec URL.
Run liberarRecebimentoQAMobile for temporary QA activation; only QA SECURITY_READY and SUBMISSIONS_ENABLED become true.
Execute the connected interface → Apps Script → QA sheet → receipt → readback → reconciliation using synthetic identities/evidence only.
Block QA receiving at the end and preserve receipts, audit and the QA HMAC for reproducible readback.
exactApprovalGate.rollback: Set QA SUBMISSIONS_ENABLED=false (and SECURITY_READY=false if configured for closure); keep sheet/audit/receipts/HMAC. Revoke OAuth or retire deployment only if explicitly included in human approval; do not delete historical evidence.
